python3 -c "
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image

f5 = np.array(Image.open('/work/observations/obs_0005.png').convert('RGB'))

# Couch:
# Mask for couch grey/blue
couch_mask = (f5[:, :, 0] > 70) & (f5[:, :, 0] < 120) & (f5[:, :, 1] > 80) & (f5[:, :, 1] < 130) & (f5[:, :, 2] > 90) & (f5[:, :, 2] < 140)
# exclude lamp
couch_mask[:, 180:230] = False
y_c, x_c = np.where(couch_mask)
print('Couch bbox in F5: x in', x_c.min(), x_c.max(), 'y in', y_c.min(), y_c.max())
print('Couch bottom y:', y_c.max())

# White cabinet/cube:
cube_mask = (f5[:, :, 0] > 160) & (f5[:, :, 1] > 160) & (f5[:, :, 2] > 160) & (f5[:, :, 0] < 240) & (np.abs(f5[:, :, 0].astype(int) - f5[:, :, 1].astype(int)) < 15)
# in F5, cube is on the left
cube_mask[:, 220:] = False
y_cb, x_cb = np.where(cube_mask)
print('Cube bbox in F5: x in', x_cb.min(), x_cb.max(), 'y in', y_cb.min(), y_cb.max())
print('Cube bottom y:', y_cb.max())
"
